title: Zscaler API reads that return secret material

prose.text: The enrollment key is in the object a read returns ([[zpa.app-connectors.provisioning-key-tooling:key-readable-on-get]]), and the Terraform provider keeps it in state ([[zpa.terraform.resource-constraints:provisioning-key-in-state]]). The contract's read schema has no `provisioningKey` member at all, only an undescribed `nonceValue` {{divergence:provisioning-key-field-name}}.
The OTP and password reads return the values in plain text: [[zcc.api.devices-wire:otp]], [[zcc.api.devices-wire:passwords]] and [[zcc.api.devices-wire:secrets-on-get]].

prose.heading: ZPA objects whose read schema lists a secret

prose.text: {{zpa-enrollment-cert-schema}} {{zpa-api-keys-model}} {{zpa-api-keys-no-contract}} The PRA credential read schema lists password, private key and passphrase ([[zpa.api.pra-wire:credential-secrets-on-read]]). Whether live reads of these return populated, masked or empty values is open {{gap:zpa-shared-model-secrets}}.

The contract lists the pre-shared key on read while the provider does not read it back: [[zia.traffic-forwarding.vpn-credentials:psk-live-read]], [[zia.terraform.traffic-forwarding-resources:vpn-credential-psk-omitted]].

checks.do: For an enrollment certificate, whether privateKeyPresent is true before treating the private key as readable.

ztw-api-key-value.statement: The Cloud Connector contract's GET /apiKeys response lists each key's `keyValue`, a string described as the API key value of 12 alphanumeric characters, not marked read-only; the Go SDK models it as `KeyValue` on the `/ztw/api/v1/apiKeys` endpoint, and the contract rotates a key with POST /apiKeys/{keyId}/regenerate.

ztw-prov-url.conditions: Corrected: the legacy reference said the list returns only desc, id and name; the current OpenAPI list schema carries provUrl and provUrlData too. The provUrlData server members were read from both schemas at the pin.

zpa-enrollment-cert-schema.statement: The ZPA contract's GET enrollmentCert/{id} response lists `privateKey`, `zrsaencryptedprivatekey` and `zrsaencryptedsessionkey` as strings, alongside `privateKeyPresent`, a read-only boolean applicable only to GET calls.

privateKeyPresent.description: Read only property. Applicable only for GET calls, ignored in PUT/POST calls.

zpa-api-keys-model.statement: The Go SDK's ZPA `APIKeys` struct, used for the `/apiKeys` endpoint, carries a `ClientSecret` field tagged `clientSecret`.

zpa-api-keys-no-contract.statement: The captured ZPA contract has no apiKeys operation, so no published response schema says whether a read returns `clientSecret`.
zpa-api-keys-no-contract.conditions: Absence from a search: the paths of automate-zscaler/openapi/zpa.openapi.json were searched at the pin for "apiKeys" and "api-keys"; none matched.

provisioning-key-field-name.summary: The contract's schema for reading a ZPA provisioning key has no `provisioningKey` member, while the Go SDK and the Terraform provider read the key from `provisioningKey`; the contract's only candidate is an undescribed `nonceValue`, and no source says the two are the same field.

positions.says: The contract's GET provisioningKey/{id} response has a `nonceValue` string and no `provisioningKey` member.
The Go SDK reads the key from `provisioningKey`, which the Terraform provider stores in state.

provisioning-key-field-name.impact: A client built from the contract alone finds no provisioning key member in the read response; the SDK naming is what consumers read today, and whether nonceValue carries the same value is unknown.

zpa-shared-model-secrets.title: Whether ZPA reads return populated secrets for API keys, PRA credentials and enrollment certificates
zpa-shared-model-secrets.detail: The ZPA API key, PRA credential and enrollment certificate models carry secret fields that are shared with create requests, and the contract lists the PRA and enrollment certificate secrets on GET, but no consumer reads them back and no live read is captured; the enrollment certificate's privateKeyPresent flag suggests the key may be withheld when Zscaler holds it. Whether each read returns the secret, a masked value or nothing is unverified.
zpa-shared-model-secrets.blocks: deciding whether a read-only client that can reach these objects can obtain credentials
